22 September 2026
Christie Group plc
("Christie Group" or the "Company")
New Corporate Website

Christie Group plc (CTG.L), the leading provider of Professional & Financial Services and Stock & Inventory Systems & Services to the healthcare, hospitality, leisure, medical, childcare & education and retail sectors, today announces the launch of its new corporate website.

The refreshed website has been designed to provide shareholders, clients and other key stakeholders with a clearer understanding of the Group's offer, strategy and its wealth of expertise within its chosen sectors. It includes dedicated pages for each of the Group's businesses - Christie & Co, Christie Finance, Christie Insurance, Pinders and Venners - as well as key market data regarding the chosen sectors in which the Group operates.

The corporate website's Investor Relations page offers a hub for investors to access the Group's latest financial results, regulatory announcements, presentations, shareholder information and corporate governance materials.
The launch of the new website supports the Group's strategy as it continues to invest in and grow its business in both the UK and Internationally.

Dan Prickett, Christie Group CEO said: "Christie Group has evolved significantly in recent years, and the Group's new website provides a clear reflection of the Company we are today, and our ambitions for the future. As well as offering a more modern look and feel, it better showcases the breadth of expertise across our business and the depth of specialist knowledge across our chosen sectors. We look forward to using the new platform to communicate with shareholders, clients and other key stakeholders as we continue to invest in and grow our business."
The new corporate website is available at: https://www.christiegroup.com/

Shareholders can also sign up to the Alert Service, to receive notifications on the Group's latest news and regulatory announcements through the website at: https://www.christiegroup.com/investors/alert-service

Notes to Editors:

Christie Group plc, quoted on AIM, is a leading professional business services group with 32 offices across the UK and Europe, catering to its specialist markets in the healthcare, hospitality, leisure, medical, childcare & education and retail sectors.

Christie Group operates in two complementary business divisions: Professional & Financial Services (PFS) and Stock & Inventory Systems & Services (SISS). These divisions trade under the brand names: PFS - Christie & Co, Pinders, Christie Finance and Christie Insurance: SISS - Venners.

Tracing its origins back to 1896, the Group has a long-established reputation for offering valued services to client companies in agency, valuation services, investment, consultancy, project management, stock audit and inventory management. The diversity of these services provides a natural balance to the Group's core agency business.
